description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Wind)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Your Friend Mode], and [Rampage Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Your Friend Mode
description.text: Increases Feral Awakening level by 1 after an ally uses a Lightning or Wind ability, removed after triggering 6 times

description.name: Rampage Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and decreases Feral Awakening level by 1 after using Rampage if the character's Feral Awakening level is 1 or greater
